reviewedDelta: Every commit in the range read as a diff (c86770a, 9ac09ab, c71285b, d6a2b11, c0e9330, ac4f2d6, 7db7d25, 94fb564), plus the staged M19.8 for coherence. check-commits --range: 8/8 pass, exit 0. check-trace --milestone M19 --priority M,S: exit 1, all 12 M19 IDs untraced (expected before feature rows). node --test on milestone-checks, verify-leg, build-settle and checkpoint tests: 92/92 pass. Licence allow list (thresholds.mjs:98) confirms robust-predicates (Unlicense) is outside it. ADR-0052/0053/0054 fit: flips in transform since 1.0; ADR-0054 defines core:path's path field.

findings.summary: ADR-0052's r2 minors (turned-frame flip 2φ−θ, hidden drop targets, leaving a frame nested in a group) are recorded only in 7db7d25's body; the ADR and M19.10 do not carry them.
findings.evidence: 7db7d25 body; ADR-0052 flip rule and Confirmation pin the unturned case only.

findings.summary: M19.10's row and the frames gate leg cover only move and reparent; ADR-0052's resize reversal, turn/flip, padding precedence and live adoption are neither in the row nor gated.
findings.evidence: m19-complete frames leg runs frames.test.ts with no named cases; a member-scaling resize mutant passes.

findings.summary: M19.7's acceptance and M19.md's Decide line name polygon-clipping vs paper.js; ADR-0053 chose polybooljs.
ADR-0053 promises the same bytes in every engine but Confirmation checks determinism in Node only; a 10° turn test via atan2/acos can round differently across engines.
The hand-off target test does not constrain the Deferred row to name the source milestone.
findings.evidence: milestone-checks.test.mjs has no case citing the finding and naming only the target milestone.

findings.summary: progress.md names pre-land shas for M19.6/M19.7; the staged M19.8 bullet says legacy:table and a masterId removal, contrary to ADR-0054.
M19.32's cause was read from the code, not measured; no Windows run after ac4f2d6 is recorded as confirming it.
findings.evidence: progress.md M19.32; run 43650494988 green without the fix.

dispositions.note: M19.10's acceptance now carries the ADR-0052 amendment for r2 F1–F3 with frames.test.ts cases (turned-frame flip 2φ − θ, hidden frame never a drop target, leaving a frame nested in a group). The nested-group case is decided: the member leaves the frame and joins the group.
M19.10's acceptance lists ADR-0052's Confirmation as named cases and the select-tool.test.ts resize-handle cases; the row names the frames gate leg's named cases, written with the feature.

The licence finding (robust-predicates is Unlicense) widened the choice; ADR-0053 records it and the row's intent (choose the library with precision, bounds, package and licence) is met. M19.md's Decide line is corrected in this record.

M19.18's acceptance: the turn limit uses dot and cross products against a constant cos 10°, and a three-engine e2e (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) shows each golden's bytes, a turned operand included, equal to Node's.
Real but small: the implementation does check the source milestone; the missing case is added on the next edit of milestone-checks.test.mjs's hand-off block.
progress.md shas fixed in this record (7db7d25, 94fb564); M19.8's acceptance now requires its progress entry to agree with ADR-0054 (legacy-table, masterId left alone).
Under ADR-0176, a build-settle failure on Windows after ac4f2d6 counts as attempt 2 for M19.32's cause and needs timed annotations of each step before attempt 3.
